what: Decoupled training (margin discrimination + (p-0.5)^2 calibration + KL-to-base fluency leash) on a frozen Qwen3-4B + LoRA(rank16), trained 8 epochs to convergence. Native yes/no forward only (no helper decoder). Numbers are means over 3 seeds unless noted. Regularized from the internal consolidated metrics file (per-run outputs produced by run.py, internalize.py, summarized by analyze.py).

determinate.desc: scene uniquely fixes the word sense, gold yes/no determinate

ambiguous.desc: neutral scene + sense-A yes/no question; both senses valid, target p(yes)=0.5 from external enumeration of the two senses

metric: native p(yes)=sigmoid(logit_yes - logit_no); determinate=accuracy, ambiguous=|p(yes)-0.5| and entropy, fluency=perplexity ratio to base

headline_working_point.note: both targets met simultaneously at lam_shape=40

shuffle.note: near chance -> determinate recovery is a real signal, not memorization

matched_discrimination_decoupled_vs_coup.rule: smallest lam_shape whose mean determinate accuracy >= coupled (0.947); here lam_shape=1 (0.963). Paired bootstrap over held-out ambiguous items: delta = |p-0.5|_coupled - |p-0.5|_decoupled (positive = decoupled better calibrated).
matched_discrimination_decoupled_vs_coup.also: lam_shape=40 dominates coupled on both axes (accuracy 0.970 > 0.947 and |p-0.5| 0.038 << 0.408)

change_in_native_forward_not_at_probe.rule: on the SAME answering forward, train a layer-swept linear readout to predict gold yes/no; compare readout accuracy to native accuracy on the same gen_test items. readout-minus-native near 0 = change is in the native forward; large positive = masked at the probe.
change_in_native_forward_not_at_probe.note: frozen base: external readout adds +0.32 over the native forward (the answer is decodable but unused). After the adapter: readout adds ~0 (lam_shape=20 cleanest, every seed <= +0.014).

fluency.conclusion: fluency maintained (8-epoch measured ratios cluster near 1.0)
fluency.source: this 8-epoch run, decoupled across all lam_shape and seeds
fluency.footnote_2epoch_smoke: an earlier 2-epoch smoke run reported 0.93-0.98 (decoupled 0.956, coupled 0.96, shuffle 0.95); the authoritative figures here are the 8-epoch measurements
